title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — reconciled weighted implementation roadmap scorecard — WorkPass56
method: WorkPass56 integrates opt-in bounded semantic-index maintenance into canonical MemoryOS2/MemoryFabric, with stale-content guards, bounded derived cache, retry backoff, lexical fallback and serialized provider access. LocalEmbeddingProvider also redacts common credentials/contact identifiers before cache and outbound HTTP. These implementation closures do not prove target-device quality; the broad independent retrieval benchmark remains recallDelta=0, so the overall weighted score stays unchanged.

completed: Canonical MemoryOS2 has an opt-in bounded background semantic-index worker scheduled by existing MemoryFabric.maintain(); writes do not wait for embeddings.

Vectors are dimension/finite/nonzero validated and only accepted if memory remains active with unchanged content hash; the derived index is bounded and backoff is content-bound with a five-minute cap.

Background indexing, live cognition and concurrent semantic Inspector requests share a serialized provider lane; foreground cognition falls back to canonical lexical/fuzzy retrieval while provider is busy.

LocalEmbeddingProvider removes common API/bearer credentials, private-key blocks, emails, phone-like values, credentialed URL secrets and long numeric identifiers before cache fingerprinting and HTTP transmission; aggregate redaction counts only are exposed.
The Memory Inspector reports aggregate index progress/retry/error status without exposing memory content.
Adapted deferred batching/retry from retained Hexis MIT source without importing a second memory database/runtime.
